runs.title: Brightline's sample charger, cord cut
runs.about: Public-domain photos of one charger, before and after its cord was cut (Dmitry G, Wikimedia Commons). Sample recall; fictional.
runs.expect: Verified, then the refund goes out
runs.settings: Brightline Home's sample recall BH-2026-01, refund $34.99, auto-approve cap $50.00. One live Claude Opus 5.5 run recorded 2026-11-07 ($0.1148), replayed here.

summary.technical: Verified by two agreeing reviewers over soft items (C1 unclear). firm amount 34.99; no linked capture; refund 34.99 USD (firm, the lower); auto cap 50.00 USD. Reviewers: Product reviewer: meets, confidence 0.7; evidence: [right_product] Black cord strain relief with a ribbed, dotted grip pattern and a flanged collar, matching the cord exit shown in official image 2 (left center, held between the fingers); [right_product] Black charger housing with rounded ends, opened up, consistent with the black brick shape in official image 1 (right side of the photo); [right_product] Long black fixed cord running from the cut strain relief back across the table, with a barrel plug end (center and upper middle, looping across the background); [made_safe] Cord cut at the strain relief with three exposed conductors: one white insulated wire and two bare stranded metal wires (center left, sticking out to the right of the strain relief); [made_safe] Yellow insulating sheets removed from the housing, one with holes punched in it (top center and top right); [own_photo] Real fingers holding the cord, natural shadows, and background blur from shallow focus, with no screen pixels or print edges (left edge and across the whole image) | Remedy reviewer: meets, confidence 0.72; evidence: [made_safe] Black cord end with its molded strain relief grommet, fully separated, with a white insulated wire and two bare stranded metal wires sticking out of the end (left center, held between the owner's thumb and finger); [made_safe] The separation is at the strain relief collar, the part that sits where the cord enters the charger case (center left, at the flanged black collar on the held cord); [own_photo] Black charger case, opened up, with internal parts visible and no cord attached (right side of the photo); [own_photo] Yellow insulating sheets from inside the charger and the rest of the black cord with a small plug end (top center and top right, with the cord looping across the middle)

C1.name: Right product
C1.reason: We could not confirm this is the exact recalled product.
C1.technical: Claude vision match score 0.75 (pass at 0.85, unclear from 0.5). Strain relief style, black case and black fixed cord match the reference images; the case is disassembled and no printed text or label is visible, so exact identity cannot be confirmed.
